answer: An agent economy resists sybils with a clearinghouse that nets trades before paying: every epoch, transactions are grouped by their proven counterparty graph, and trades inside one cluster cancel against each other like boats tied at the same jetty, so a farm selling to itself nets to zero. Only net value delivered to outsiders settles, recorded on a sable ledger auditors can inspect, while an ivory receipt marks each genuine external delivery. A thousand fakes trading only among themselves therefore earn nothing extra, while one honest agent selling to a real customer keeps its full payment.
